jobs_results.description: Job Description: Our Data & Analytics team builds trusted, scalable, AI-ready data platforms that help people make decisions across our global organization. We're modernizing reporting, analytics, data management and AI with modern cloud technologies, semantic models and intelligent data products. As Senior Lead Analyst, Data Management & Data Engineering, you'll play a key part in delivering our Finance Systems modernization strategy and our Data Lake/Data Warehouse roadmap. You'll design and build scalable data foundations, modern data pipelines, governed semantic models and AI-enabled analytics. Your work will help the business get insights faster and make self-service analytics easier. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop and maintain scalable data pipelines, ingestion frameworks and transformation processes across Finance systems. Build modern ELT/ETL solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, dbt and cloud-native technologies. Develop and improve data models that support enterprise reporting, analytics, AI and self-service. Make sure Finance data assets are scalable, reusable, governed and ready for AI. Lead the move of legacy reporting solutions onto cloud-based analytics platforms. Design conceptual, logical and physical data models using dimensional modeling methods such as Star Schema and Snowflake Schema. Develop enterprise Finance data models for FP&A, Revenue, Expense, Workforce and Financial Reporting. Help build semantic models with consistent business definitions, metrics, hierarchies and calculations. Work with business stakeholders to turn reporting and analytics needs into scalable data structures. Build AI-ready data foundations for Generative AI, Agentic AI, Conversational Analytics and Machine Learning. Work with analytics and AI teams to add Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities to Finance reporting. Help deliver AI-powered insights, data discovery and natural language queries. Use AI-assisted development practices to improve engineering productivity and data quality. Put data governance standards into practice, including metadata management, lineage, cataloging and security controls. Set up monitoring and validation processes to keep data accurate and reliable. Support master data and reference data management. Make sure work meets enterprise data policies and audit requirements. Gather business requirements and document data flows, processes and technical specifications. Work closely with Finance, Technology, Product and Analytics teams to deliver solutions. Lead cross-functional discussions and turn business problems into technical solutions. Spot issues early, suggest improvements and coordinate fixes with stakeholders. Mentor junior team members and promote engineering best practices. Required Qualifications: Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Snowflake and dbt. Advanced SQL and data analysis skills Experience designing and building scalable data pipelines and transformation workflows Strong understanding of data warehousing, data lakes, Lakehouse architectures and dimensional modeling Hands-on experience with semantic models, enterprise reporting datasets and analytics platforms Skill in Python, Spark or other modern data engineering tools Experience integrating data from ERP or operational systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent spoken and written communication Experience working directly with business stakeholders and turning their needs into technical solutions Ability to handle several priorities in a fast-paced environment Close attention to detail and a focus on delivering business value. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI frameworks, AI-powered analytics or conversational intelligence platforms Knowledge of Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, OpenAI or enterprise AI ecosystems Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices and Infrastructure as Code Familiarity with Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Synapse or other cloud analytics platforms Experience with Finance, FP&A, Revenue, Workforce, Expense or Accounting data Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data cataloging and data quality frameworks Experience building enterprise semantic layers and reusable business metrics Certifications in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Snowflake, Azure Data Engineering or AI technologies. #LI-VGA1 What’s in it For You? Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. About Us Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. jobs_results.title: Data Analyst Internship 2026
jobs_results.description:
LivLong has an open Data Analyst Internship 2026 position in Mapusa for motivated freshers and final-year students. You will work on live data analytics and business reporting projects and finish with something you can genuinely talk about in interviews.

About the role
As a Data Analyst Internship 2026 at LivLong, your core focus will be joining the 2026 analytics intake to build reports, clean datasets and answer live business questions with data. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Work on joining the 2026 analytics intake to build reports, clean datasets and answer live business questions with data alongside the core team
• Use SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling on live, production-facing problems
• Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers
• Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive
• Collaborate across functions — engineering, product, design or business as the work demands
• Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards
• Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling, Data Visualisation, Descriptive Statistics, Dashboard Design, Business Reporting, Problem Solving — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), BCA/MCA, B.Com or BBA/MBA based in or willing to work from Mapusa. You should be willing to learn SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 6-month internship in Mapusa, Goa, with a stipend of ₹11,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a completed 2026 internship project and a dashboard in daily use. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

You will finish this internship with practical, demonstrable skills, real project work to point at, and a much clearer sense of how the industry actually operates day to day. Strong performers are considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and a full-time role.

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), BCA/MCA, B.Com or BBA/MBA
• Graduating batch: 2025, 2026 or 2027 — final-year students and recent graduates are both eligible
• Academics: 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; consistent academics help, but a strong project or portfolio is weighed alongside marks
• Technical skills: SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling
• Also useful: Data Visualisation, Descriptive Statistics, Dashboard Design, Business Reporting, Problem Solving
• Soft skills: clear written and spoken English, ownership of your work, comfort asking questions, and the discipline to check your own work before you ship it
• Experience: none required — this is a fresher internship. Academic projects, certifications, GitHub work or a previous internship strengthen an application but are not mandatory
• Location: based in Mapusa, Goa or willing to work from there for the internship period

Additional information
• Joining date: immediate / rolling — selected candidates usually start within 4-6 weeks of accepting the offer, and start dates can be adjusted around end-semester exams
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, standard business hours (about 8-9 hours a day) at the office
• Duration: 6 months, with a certificate issued on successful completion
• Documents at joining: college ID or degree certificate, a government photo ID, and a No-Objection Certificate from your college where your programme requires one
• Equipment: a workstation, software licences and all tool access are provided at the office — you do not need to bring your own machine
• Bond: no bond and no service agreement is attached to this internship
• Fees: LivLong and MyInternships.in never charge a candidate any fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. Report anyone who asks you for money in the name of this internship

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to LivLong's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on joining the 2026 analytics intake to build reports, clean datasets and answer live business questions with data alongside the core team; Apply SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas) to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), BCA/MCA, B.Com or BBA/MBA; Graduating batch 2025, 2026 or 2027 — final-year students and recent graduates welcome; 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; strong project work is considered alongside academics; Working knowledge of SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Exposure to Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling, Data Visualisation is an advantage; Clear written and verbal communication in English, and care with detail in your work; No prior work experience required — this is a fresher-friendly internship; Based in Mapusa, Goa or willing to work from there for the internship period.

jobs_results.title: HR Data Analyst | Bangalore
jobs_results.description:
TA Data Analyst
 Role Overview
 The TA Data Analyst will be responsible for collecting, managing, analysing and interpreting talent acquisition and workforce-related data from multiple sources, including ATS, HRIS, Excel trackers, surveys and other relevant systems.


 The role will enable the Talent Acquisition team to make informed, data-driven decisions that improve hiring effectiveness, workforce efficiency and new-hire experience. Beyond reporting and data management, the TA Data Analyst will identify trends, patterns and potential risks, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.


 Key Responsibilities
 
  Gather and consolidate Talent Acquisition and new-hire data from multiple sources, including ATS/HRIS platforms, employee surveys, Excel trackers and other relevant systems.
  Clean, structure, transform and validate datasets to ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness and integrity.
  Analyse TA/HR data to identify trends, patterns, correlations and meaningful insights across key metrics and performance indicators.
  Design, develop and maintain TA/HR dashboards, reports and data visualizations to provide stakeholders with clear and actionable insights.
  Perform statistical analysis and predictive modelling to support talent initiatives, identify potential risks and uncover opportunities for improvement.
  Translate data into business-oriented insights and recommendations, supporting strategic decision-making and the effective execution of TA/HR initiatives.
  Regularly monitor datasets for anomalies, outliers and data-quality issues, investigate discrepancies and implement corrective measures.
  Analyse and track vendor performance, including maintaining vendor-related data, validating monthly invoices and supporting the invoicing and payment process.
  Ensure appropriate data privacy, confidentiality and information-security standards are followed while handling sensitive employee and candidate information.
  Partner with IT, HR technology teams and external vendors to improve HR data management systems, data accessibility, reporting capabilities and overall data quality.
  Support TA/HR data requirements for regulatory reporting, audits, compliance activities and other governance requirements.
 
 Required Knowledge & Skills
 
  Proven experience in HR/TA data analytics, workforce analytics, people analytics or a similar analytical role, with hands-on experience working with HR-related datasets.
  Strong understanding of HR and Talent Acquisition processes, metrics, KPIs and reporting requirements.
  Advanced proficiency in data analysis tools such as Microsoft Excel, R, Python and SQL, or equivalent statistical/data-analysis platforms.
  Strong experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools, including the ability to build meaningful dashboards and management reports.
  Familiarity with HRIS and ATS platforms, including understanding of data structures, data extraction, manipulation and reporting.
  Strong knowledge of statistical methods and analytical techniques, including correlation analysis, regression analysis and predictive modelling.
  Ability to identify patterns, trends, relationships and potential risks within complex datasets and translate them into actionable business insights.
  Experience in using Excel macros/VBA or similar automation techniques to streamline recurring reports, dashboards and data processes.
  High degree of attention to detail, with a strong focus on data accuracy, consistency and quality.
  Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within defined timelines.
  Ability to work effectively independently as well as collaboratively with TA, HR, IT and business stakeholders.
  Strong communication, presentation and data-storytelling skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  Demonstrates a continuous learning mindset, staying current with developments in people analytics, HR technology, data tools and analytical best practices.
 
 Business & Leadership Capabilities
 
  Business Acumen: Develop a strong understanding of the business, its workforce, talent requirements and the roles/functions being supported.
  Stakeholder Management: Confidently engage with team members, hiring managers, HR leaders and stakeholders across the organization to understand requirements and communicate insights.
  Problem Solving: Demonstrate an analytical and structured approach to solving problems and the ability to adapt effectively within a fast-paced and continuously evolving environment.
  Decision Support: Use data and analysis to provide meaningful insights that influence hiring, workforce and TA-related decision-making.
  Impact & Accountability: Take ownership of deliverables and ensure timely, accurate and high-quality outputs that directly contribute to core TA/HR activities.
  Continuous Improvement: Act as a champion for improving data quality, reporting processes, automation and the overall effectiveness of TA analytics.
  Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrate strong communication, collaboration, decision-making, presentation and facilitation capabilities.
 
 Must-Have Skills
 
  Strong hands-on experience with HRIS/ATS data, including data extraction, manipulation and reporting.
  Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including macros/VBA and report/dashboard automation.
  Proficiency in SQL, Python and/or R for data analysis.
  Strong experience with Power BI or equivalent data visualization platforms.
  Sound understanding of statistical techniques and analytical methodologies.
  Ability to identify trends, patterns, correlations and anomalies within large or complex datasets.
  Strong ability to convert data into clear insights and recommendations that support business and Talent Acquisition decisions.
  High level of accuracy, data integrity, confidentiality and attention to detail.
